body.name: singularity-safe Anderson--Rubin inversion
body.construction: For a fixed deterministic calibration constant \(t_{\alpha_0}\), set \(\mathcal C_n=\{b\in[-B,B]:\max_{d+2\le k\le R_{\max}}\lVert\widehat Q(\widehat m_k-b\widehat c_k)\rVert_2\le t_{\alpha_0}/\sqrt n\}\), using \([-B,B]\) if the displayed set is empty or an environment has fewer than \(R_{\max}\) observations.
